title: ר' יצחק בר חנינא

paragraphs: R. Yitzḥak bar Ḥanina said in the name of Rav Huna, Ketubbot (4b). Bar Ḥananyah said in the name of Rav Huna, Af Al Pi (61a), several statements; Nedarim (38b). In Berakhot (52b): R. Yose bar Ḥanina said in the name of Rav Huna. In my opinion this is a scribal error and should read R. Yitzḥak bar Ḥanina; so it is in Rif and Asheri. In Sanhedrin (38, beginning of side b), R. Yoḥanan bar Ḥanina may be a scribal error, since it was written ר״י ב״ח. There is also R. Yehudah bar Ḥanina. Rav Ḥinena, or Ḥanina, bar Rav Yitzḥak may be his son.
